data.text:
Cursor just shipped an iOS app — and the timing tells you everything about where agentic coding is heading.

SpaceX/xAI acquired Cursor earlier this month. Six days later, the first Cursor iOS app hits the App Store. That's not a coincidence — that's Elon turning a coding IDE into an anywhere-accessible agent platform.

WHAT THE APP DOES:
- Launch coding agents from your phone
- Review diffs and merge PRs
- Annotate screenshots for visual feedback
- Voice conversations with agents
- Track active engineering work

MY TAKE:
This is the first real sign of what the SpaceX acquisition unlocks. Cursor isn't just an IDE anymore — it's a remote command center for AI agents that runs in your pocket. The "Remote Control" feature they previewed lets you spin up cloud agents from the app and hand off between local and cloud environments.

The pricing signal is also aggressive: 75% off Composer 2.5 runs through July 5. They want developer adoption fast.

The direction is clear: within 12 months, running agents from mobile won't seem unusual. It'll be the default.
